business_problem: AVEX lacked a single, transparent service channel for customer requests, incidents, and change tickets, so communication broke down between agents and customers and case progress was hard for both sides to see.
solution_summary: AVEX rebuilt customer service around ServiceNow so every request could move through one visible workflow instead of fragmented email and phone exchanges. Customer Service Management became the central orchestration layer for the new unified portal, where customers raise tickets, receive instant feedback, review AVEX's actions, and manage notification preferences from one place. The same portal also captures quotation requests and routes them to the sales desk without leaving the workflow, so the full path from request to quote to installation stays on a shared record. Field Service Management extends that process into delivery and execution, while the FSM mobile app gives engineers a day-of-work view of assignments, destinations, and issue context. Dashboards and reporting on the Now Platform give employees oversight of service performance while customers gain end-to-end visibility.

solution_components.name: Customer Service Management
solution_components.role: Runs the centralized customer portal, case handling, and communication workflow for requests, incidents, and change tickets.

solution_components.name: Field Service Management
solution_components.role: Extends the workflow from customer request handling into field execution and installation tracking.

solution_components.name: FSM mobile app
solution_components.role: Shows AVEX engineers their tasks, destinations, and issue details so field work can be executed efficiently.

data_flow: Customers submit tickets or quotation requests through the unified portal, where Customer Service Management centralizes updates and feedback. Requests that need field execution continue through Field Service Management, and engineers use the FSM mobile app to work assignments while customers track progress through installation in the same portal.
business_outcome: AVEX created a centralized customer-service portal with clearer communication, full case visibility, automated quote-to-installation workflow tracking, and a simpler operating model for both customers and field engineers.
architecture_clues: Customers can select or deselect automated notifications in the portal.
Quotation requests are automatically shared with the sales desk inside the same portal workflow.
AVEX engineers use the FSM mobile app to see where they need to go and what issues await them.
evidence_quotes: It needed an effective service solution that would improve communication between agent and customer and provide full case visibility in the event of a request, incident, or change ticket.
AVEX sought a solution that would provide customers with a single point of information, with all communication around a request ticket centralized.
AVEX adopted ServiceNow Customer Service Management and deployed Field Service Management (FSM), and now the customer has visibility of a wealth of information.
Customers are now able to raise quotations via the service portal, which is automatically then shared with the sales desk.
Now that AVEX engineers are using the FSM mobile app, they have a full overview of their tasks for the day ahead.
